visualCharacteristics.purpose: benefit comparison matrix across membership tiers with check icons for included benefits
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-width table; first column (benefit) left-aligned and sticky when the table scrolls horizontally on small screens; tier columns centered

contentPattern.structure: row 1: corner label then one cell per tier (tier name and qualifying nights); then one row per benefit: cell 1 bold benefit name, description and optional "More Details" link; one cell per tier holding a check icon (included), a short value, or nothing (not included)

cells: Ambassador Elite / Stay 100 nights/year + $23,000 USD Spend
Bold benefit name, description, optional link

usage: Program and partner benefit comparisons by tier.
reuseGuidance: Use for any feature-by-plan matrix. Give check icons alt text such as "Included" so the table reads correctly to screen readers. For plain data tables use table.
